definition.simple: Valency is the number of 'hands' an atom has to hold onto other atoms.
definition.academic: Valency is the combining capacity of an element. It represents the number of electrons an atom needs to lose, gain, or share to become stable.

common_misconceptions: Valency is the total number of electrons in an atom.
All elements have only one fixed valency.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Explain valency using an octopus: if an octopus has 8 arms and a human has 2, how many humans can an octopus hold? Valency works the same way.
